hypotheses.justification: Split on 0 ≤ T. In that case, use the existing proof. Otherwise T < 0, so Icc 0 T is empty by Set.Icc_eq_empty_of_lt. By the definition of AnnularEnvelope.timePositionVolume, Measure.restrict_empty and Measure.zero_prod, both conclusions use the zero measure. Each then follows from MeasureTheory.uniformIntegrable_zero_meas, regardless of the densities.
